prompts: The backend in {WS} (Pixel Arena) has the integration test in {WS}/tests/integration failing, while the unit tests pass. Find and fix ALL root causes following the specification in {WS}/docs (not just the symptom of the visible test). Do not change any existing test. Use the Python standard library only. At the end run the whole suite with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` from {WS}. This is your ONLY request: there will be no second turn; deliver everything fixed and summarize the root cause + file:line of each bug.
answers:
[goal] Fix the failing integration test, and every root cause behind it, per docs/.
[action] Fixed three bugs. I didn't touch the tests.
[result] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` prints `Ran 13 tests in 0.004s` and `OK`.

Root causes:
1. `arena_server/config/loader.py:14-21`: the JSON file was applied after the env vars, so the file overrode them. docs/CONFIG.md says env wins. The file is now applied first and env last.
2. `arena_server/persistence/codec.py:13` (`decode`): `credits` was written by `encode` but never passed to `Profile` on load, so credits reset to 0. It now restores `credits`.
3. `arena_server/economy/payout.py:6-8`: rounding used float `floor(x/10+0.5)`, which can mis-round exact halves. docs/ECONOMY.md requires halves to round up (1425 -> 1430). It now uses `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. I didn't run a case that fails on the old float code, so this one is a spec-safety fix and not a reproduced failure.

`arena_server/economy/legacy_payout.py` is deprecated and unused, so I left it alone.

[next] None.
